name: Opening range (hourly / post-premarket model language)

definitions.definition_text: In the same lecture that defines NY OR as post-9:30 30 minutes: '7 o'clock to 7:30, that is your pre-market range. 7:30 to 8:00 is your opening range.' And: '9 to 9:30, that's your pre-market range… post 9:30 to 10:00. That's your opening range.'
conditions: Paired with a preceding 30-minute pre-market range on the hour
Framed as something you can do on every hourly candle
definitions.timeframe_session_context: NY local morning hours; model generalizes 30m pre-market then 30m 'opening range' after each hour start
definitions.variations_note: KEEP SEPARATE from opening_range_ny_30m. Same speaker/video uses 'opening range' for (a) NY 9:30–10:00 and (b) 7:30–8:00 after 7:00–7:30 pre-market. Do not merge.
